shared_elements: upright rectangular stone slab/pillar with a flat carved face
quadruped animal shown in profile, in low relief
simplified outline/raised-relief carving on a plain ground
surrounding dry-stone rubble walling and excavated earth
justification: Both show a tall rectangular monolith whose broad face carries a low-relief quadruped in strict profile, rendered as a simple raised silhouette against an undecorated ground, and both stand within excavated rubble-walled surroundings. The decisive difference is density and organisation: A is crowded with stacked registers, a banded horizontal strip, small human-like figures and a bird, while B carries a single isolated animal on an otherwise blank shaft, so the compositional schemes barely correspond.
